data.name: Mindcraft
data.detailed_description:
Roll Your Way to Victory

Mindcraft is a challenging 3D puzzle game that will test your spatial reasoning and strategic thinking. Control a rectangular block as you navigate through beautifully crafted levels, rolling and tumbling your way to the goal. But be careful - one wrong move could send you plummeting into the void!

Key Features

🎮 Intuitive Yet Deep Gameplay

  • Simple controls: just swipe or use arrow keys to roll

  • Complex puzzles that require careful planning and precise execution

  • Perfect for both casual players and puzzle enthusiasts

🧩 198 Hand-picked Levels

  • Progress through 7 unique worlds, each with its own theme and challenges

  • Difficulty gradually increases from simple tutorials to mind-bending puzzles

  • Optional "perfect" solutions for expert players seeking an extra challenge

⚡ Unique Mechanics & Obstacles

  • Lasers: Time your movements to avoid deadly beams that fire in patterns

  • Switches & Walls: Activate colored switches to lower matching walls

  • Glass Floors: Fragile surfaces that shatter if you stand upright

  • Bridges: Activate switches to rotate bridges into position

  • Moving Obstacles: Dodge patrolling hazards that move after each turn

  • One-Stroke Paths: Leave obstacles behind as you move, blocking your return

  • Ghost Chase: Take too long, and a ghost will appear to hunt you down!

💎 Letter Collection System

  • Find hidden letters D-R-E-A-M-S-C-A-P-E scattered throughout levels

  • Collect complete sets to permanently increase your maximum health

  • Adds replayability as you hunt for missed collectibles

🎯 Score & Progression System

  • Earn points based on efficiency - fewer moves mean higher scores

  • Track your perfect clears and compete for the best solutions

  • Unlock new worlds as you progress through the adventure

Perfect for Puzzle Lovers

Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser during a break or a challenging puzzle to solve over time, Mindcraft offers satisfying "aha!" moments when you discover the solution. The game respects your intelligence while remaining accessible, never relying on hidden information or unfair tricks.

Features at a Glance

  • Clean, minimalist 3D art style

  • Smooth animations and satisfying physics

  • Multiple input methods: touch, keyboard, and gamepad support

  • No time pressure (except when the ghost appears!)

  • Retry levels instantly with no loading screens

  • Cloud save support to continue your progress anywhere

Start simple, master the basics, then face increasingly complex challenges that will push your puzzle-solving skills to the limit. Can you collect all the letters, achieve perfect scores, and conquer every world?

Acknowledgement

※ This game received partial development funding from the Korea Content Agency's ‘2025 Future Technology Game Production Support’ program.

data.short_description: A mind-bending 3D puzzle game where you roll a block through increasingly complex levels. Master unique mechanics like lasers, switches, and collapsing glass floors while collecting hidden letters to unlock permanent upgrades in this challenging brain teaser.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 / AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5850 / Intel HD Graphics 4600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
